name: Tayyab Sajjad
headline: UK accounting experience. Clear working papers. Practical support.
intro: An accountant with UK practice experience in bookkeeping, reconciliations, accounts preparation and management reporting — including construction-related businesses.

roles.title: Accountant
roles.summary: UK client accounting, preparation and construction reporting.
bullets: Maintain bookkeeping in Xero, QuickBooks Online and Sage; reconcile bank, credit-card and control-account balances.
Prepare VAT and CIS returns with supporting checks on records, deductions and balances ahead of submission.
Track construction project costs, maintenance expenditure and budget movements; prepare profitability and management reports.
Prepare financial reports, creditors analyses, payroll records and journals; reconcile PAYE and VAT balances with client and HMRC records.
Prepare Self Assessment and Corporation Tax supporting records and computations within the firm’s review processes.
Communicate directly with UK clients to resolve queries and obtain information for accounting and tax deadlines.

roles.title: Junior Bookkeeper
roles.summary: Daily bookkeeping and VAT preparation for an employer’s portfolio of 10 clients.
bullets: Recorded transactions, maintained ledgers, reconciled bank accounts and organised supporting documents for a portfolio of 10 clients during this employment.
Prepared VAT returns and checked VAT boxes and tax rates before filing; escalated missing or unmatched records for resolution.
Explained errors in client records, the corrections required and the effect of those changes.

roles.title: Accounts & Tax Trainee
roles.summary: Bookkeeping and tax working-paper support under senior review.
bullets: Supported bookkeeping, transaction posting, reconciliations and tax-related working papers under senior review.

education.institution: Institute of Cost & Management Accountants of Pakistan
The Hope College of Science & Commerce
